Nothing here is invented: every row is a field the organizer typed into Mobilizon, harvested from the group feed by `npm run events:harvest`, and each row carries the URL and the fetch that put it here. D92's copy rule still binds the *page*: real dates and series names, never a frequency inferred from the rows. `npm run check:ics` fails the build on the spec traps (D72) and on any instant published without a confirmed wall clock (D169).
